svg.title: Star city
svg.desc: An isometric city with one tower per repository. Tower height is stars on a log scale, districts are the 8 catalog sections. Tallest: fresh-start (6229 stars), XActions (579 stars), cryptocurrency.cv (319 stars), three.ws (230 stars), pump-fun-sdk (134 stars), PAI (113 stars).
svg.text: 391 towers, one per repository. Height is stars on a log scale; each district is a catalog section.
